releaseNote.summary: Release 41 shipped June 19. Routines are back. Release 42 is the draft in progress.
releaseNote.plannedWindow: Release 41 shipped June 19, 2026. Release 42 is the next planned release — timing TBD.
releaseNote.details: Release 41 shipped June 19 with the big batch: routines are fully back and migrated (feat: routineth), the Slack internal formatting error fix (PDEC-8168, PR #2313), app OAuth stability improvements (toggle app authentication, oauthEnabled at create time, stale OAuth restart fix PDEC-8266), enhanced creator search, Meta v3 tag and transcript fixes (PDEC-8264, PDEC-8265, PDEC-8226), and a wide range of infrastructure improvements. Release 42 is the current draft — timing TBD.
releaseNote.statusPagePlacement: Show the next planned release with Recent Releases, alongside the upcoming release entry.

notices.summary: OAuth-gated apps can show a rough logged-out screen.
notices.impact: When someone opens an app that requires OAuth while logged out, the gated screen may look unfinished instead of showing a polished sign-in or access prompt.
notices.workaround: Log in to the right Motion/Runneth account, connect the required OAuth account if needed, then reopen or refresh the app link.

resolution.label: Fix in review
resolution.note: Several OAuth stability improvements shipped in release 41 (June 19): toggle app authentication, oauthEnabled correctly set at app create time, and stale OAuth restart (PDEC-8266). The specific contextual access-denied page (PR #2326, PDEC-8238) is still in review and targeted for the next release.

notices.statusPageGuidance: Show under Apps. This is a logged-out OAuth gate UI issue, not a general app outage.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks about or reports an app, app link, dashboard, widget, or generated page looking broken, ugly, unfinished, or confusing while logged out or blocked by OAuth.
notices.runnethGuidance: Acknowledge that OAuth-gated apps can show a rough logged-out screen, that the underlying data is fine, and that a fix (an access-denied page) is in review and targeted for the next release. Do not proactively mention this for normal requests.
notices.supportGuidance: Capture the app link, whether the person was logged out, which OAuth gate appeared, and whether the page still looks wrong after logging in and refreshing.

notices.impact: Routines were temporarily paused during the refactor.
notices.workaround: Routine plans saved during the pause can now be turned on.

resolution.label: Resolved
resolution.note: Routines shipped in release 41 (June 19, 2026). The routineth PR (PR #2116 by @lukaspili) is live. Existing routines were migrated as part of the release. Routines are back to normal — scheduled, recurring, reminder, and background work can be set up again.

notices.statusPageGuidance: Resolved in r41. Show at the bottom under Resolved, then drop off after removeAfter.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks to create, set up, schedule, monitor, remind, notify, post later, repeat, keep something updated, or run background upkeep.
notices.runnethGuidance: Routines are back as of release 41 (June 19). Route requests to create, schedule, or set up routines normally.
notices.supportGuidance: Routines are live. Any routine plans saved during the pause can now be turned on.

notices.summary: Slack internal formatting error — fixed in release 41.
notices.impact: The error line ('I hit an internal formatting error while preparing this Slack response') was appearing as the delivered Slack message instead of a real reply in some cases.
notices.workaround: No longer needed — fixed in release 41.

resolution.label: Resolved
resolution.note: Fixed in release 41 (June 19, 2026): PR #2313 (fix(agent): repair missing Slack responses from terminal output, PDEC-8168) shipped in r41. The error line should no longer appear in place of real Slack replies.

notices.statusPageGuidance: Resolved in r41. Show at the bottom under Resolved, then drop off after removeAfter.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks about or reports an 'internal formatting error' in Slack, or Runneth posting an error line after being told to stop.
notices.runnethGuidance: This is fixed in release 41 (June 19). If someone reports it on a very recent message, ask them to re-send — it may be a stale session. Do not proactively mention it for normal Slack requests.
notices.supportGuidance: Fixed in release 41 (June 19). If a customer still reports the error, capture the Slack thread link and message timestamp and check whether the org's VM has picked up r41.
notices.errorQuote: I hit an internal formatting error while preparing this Slack response. Please try again.
